description: Bridges is a dataset listed in Ramsey County open data portal (data.ramseycountymn.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Ramsey County. Ramsey County bridge inspection results. Coverage: Ramsey County, Minnesota. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are bridge, rating, truck limit, transportation, railroad. The table has 17 columns. Attribution on the portal: Ramsey County Public Works. The portal shows 2025-06-18 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ramseycountymn-gov-portal.
